name: @teqbench/tbx-ngx-http
description: Base HTTP communication services and resilience constants for Angular. Provides automatic retries with exponential backoff, timeout handling, and consistent URL resolution for feature services.

//: typescript-eslint is pinned without ^ because patch releases have historically introduced
breaking rule changes. Pin to a known-good version and update deliberately after testing.
@types/node is pinned to the major version matching the Node runtime (24). Auto-updating
to 25 pulls in type definitions for APIs not available on the target runtime, which can
mask compatibility issues. Re-evaluate when the project moves to the next even-numbered Node LTS.
@angular/build pulls vite versions affected by CVEs (GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9, GHSA-v2wj-q39q-566r, GHSA-p9ff-h696-f583).
Override pins vite to 7.3.2 directly. Re-evaluate and remove once @angular/build updates upstream to a clean vite range.
